notes.title: Version 1.2.0 is now available!
notes.content:
Changes:
[list]
[*]Fixed achievement progression not always getting displayed properly
[*]Fixed fullscreen resolution being incorrect on Mac devices with a notch and a few other macOS-related issues
[*]Fixed a minor controller configuration issue
[*]Improved achievement handling
[*]Improved controller vibration patterns
[*]Improved font and post-processing rendering quality and performance
[*]Made the intro cinematic always skippable
[*]Made the "Little Big Universe" more easily achievable during regular playthroughs
[/list]
Xbox Series S|X and Xbox One ports are coming later in 2024.

Stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Linux / Steam Deck version will be released on 3rd November!
notes.content:
Delusion will be released for Linux on 3rd November 2023.

Stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Version 1.1.0 and macOS port will be released on 18th August!
notes.content:
Changes:
[list]
[*] Added macOS support
[*] Added resolution scale setting
[*] Improved font rendering on high resolutions
[*] Several audio, engine, and tutorial-related fixes and improvements
[/list]
Also, Linux and Steam Deck versions will be coming out soon.

Delusion will be released for Linux on 3rd November 2023.

Stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Free demo and soundtrack are now available! macOS and Linux ports coming soon.
notes.content:
The original soundtrack of Delusion, composed by Tomáš Vrána, was just released. You can listen to it now, completely free of charge!

Also, a free demo showcasing the entire first chapter is available now.

macOS, Linux, and Steam Deck versions will be coming out soon.

Delusion will be released for macOS on 18th August 2023, with Linux ports following on 3rd November 2023.

Stay tuned for more updates!
